draft_en.subject: PoE switches shipped with UBITRON camera and NVR systems - in your packaging
draft_en.body:
Hello UBITRON team,

Over the past months you had a steady stream of product mails from us - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 14 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the PoE switches shipped with your camera and NVR systems (industrial units ONV-built today), in your packaging from small lots, CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $87.4 USD EXW with your logo (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); 24 x Gigabit PoE+ (280 W) + 4 x SFP, L2+ managed - STC-424DGGPM-280W - $145.7; DIN-rail industrial 8 x PoE+ + 2 x SFP, unmanaged, -40 to 75 C - STI-288GP - $62.2. KC stays on your side.

One question: which PoE SKU do you ship most with camera kits - commercial 8-port, or the industrial one?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
